brief: 25 bold, sleek candidate app icons for Parley, a TTS app that creates audiobooks and plays.

concepts.name: Signal P
concepts.concept: A single thick geometric capital P whose rounded bowl is opened by two precise horizontal soundwave cuts; a strong, instantly recognizable monogram. Voice energy is integrated into the P silhouette, never floating next to it.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: one standalone square app icon candidate for Parley, a text-to-speech app that creates audiobooks and multi-character plays.
Primary request: a bold, sleek, distinctive premium app icon that subtly hints at voice, storytelling or performance.
Style: expertly designed flat vector-like brand mark, optically balanced, confident thick shapes, exceptionally crisp edges, beautiful negative space, readable at 32 pixels.
Composition: exactly one centered symbol occupying about 62% of a perfectly square full-bleed opaque background. No rounded-square container inside the image, no outer margin, no perspective. The full image itself is the app tile. Use restrained high-contrast colors chosen to suit the concept, at most two solid colors total; keep it sophisticated.
Constraints: no app name, no words, no numbers, no captions, no letters except an expressly requested P or p monogram. No watermark, no device mockup, no shadows, no gradients, no texture, no tiny lines, no familiar existing brand logos. One coherent idea, not a pile of symbols.
Specific concept: A single thick geometric capital P whose rounded bowl is opened by two precise horizontal soundwave cuts; a strong, instantly recognizable monogram. Voice energy is integrated into the P silhouette, never floating next to it.
